consolidation_layers.question: What invariant rules must implementations obey?
What subtype/domain-specific mechanism is being studied?
How is the same operator shown to a reader?
Where is duplication or orphan pressure?

immediate_merge_queue: Spiral family: normalize specialist metadata so recurrence law, geometry, physics analogy, archaeology, benchmark and reader layers all point to canonical recurrence owners.
Public projection audit: continue converting old page-local definitions into owner links and typed reader explanations.
Legacy master audit: identify root-level or older files that still declare themselves canonical despite newer House/operator ownership.
Promotion-status system: mark research/conversation waves as unpromoted, partially promoted, absorbed/provenance-only, or still canonical-source-bearing.
Only after these are controlled, consider moving fully absorbed temporary/recovery files to archive.
success_metrics: One obvious definition/contract owner for every high-frequency operator.
Every specialist names the owner it specializes instead of repeating a generic definition.
Every research synthesis preserves provenance links to source/specialist owners.
Every public projection can be replaced without changing canonical ownership.
New files are created only when they add a distinct schema, mechanism, evidence layer, timeline or reader function.
